_schema.about: Takeoff field-length tuning to manufacturer airport-planning charts (toperf.js). Charts read off digitally from the vector curves (Airbus) or by pixel scan (Boeing) on 2026-10-18; only the numbers below are kept.
_schema.conditions: full thrust, dry, zero wind and slope, air conditioning off, optimum flaps (Boeing states these; the Airbus AC charts don't, assumed the same)
_schema.points: massKg, pressure altitude ft, ISA deviation °C → takeoff runway length ft from the chart
_schema.factor: required field length × factor × (1 + altK × pressure altitude / 1000 ft); fitted by tools/fit_to_tune.mjs
